subject: Wrong meeting link
text: Apologies for sending the wrong meeting link. That was my mistake, and I'm sorry it cost you time. I've attached the correct link and a one-page agenda. If it helps, I suggest we open with the budget question first, since that's the part you'll probably want clarified fastest. After that, the rest should go smoothly. Please tell me if the new link fails or if you'd rather have a call. I'll double-check everything before the next step today.
